new.md:
Creates a new `GtkColumnView`.

You most likely want to call [`ColumnView.append_column()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#method:append_column)
to add columns next.

doc.brief: Presents a large dynamic list of items using multiple columns with headers.
doc.md:
Presents a large dynamic list of items using multiple columns with headers.

`GtkColumnView` uses the factories of its columns to generate a cell widget for
each column, for each visible item and displays them together as the row for
this item.

The [`ColumnView:show-row-separators`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#property:show-row-separators) and
[`ColumnView:show-column-separators`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#property:show-column-separators) properties offer a simple way
to display separators between the rows or columns.

`GtkColumnView` allows the user to select items according to the selection
characteristics of the model. For models that allow multiple selected items,
it is possible to turn on *rubberband selection*, using
[`ColumnView:enable-rubberband`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#property:enable-rubberband).

The column view supports sorting that can be customized by the user by
clicking on column headers. To set this up, the `GtkSorter` returned by
[`ColumnView.get_sorter()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#method:get_sorter) must be attached to a sort model for the
data that the view is showing, and the columns must have sorters attached to
them by calling [`ColumnViewColumn.set_sorter()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnViewColumn#method:set_sorter). The initial sort
order can be set with [`ColumnView.sort_by_column()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#method:sort_by_column).

The column view also supports interactive resizing and reordering of
columns, via Drag-and-Drop of the column headers. This can be enabled or
disabled with the [`ColumnView:reorderable`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#property:reorderable) and
[`ColumnViewColumn:resizable`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnViewColumn#property:resizable) properties.

To learn more about the list widget framework, see the
[overview](section-list-widget.html).

# CSS nodes

```
columnview[.column-separators][.rich-list][.navigation-sidebar][.data-table]
├── header
│   ├── <column header>
┊   ┊
│   ╰── <column header>
│
├── listview
│
┊
╰── [rubberband]
```

`GtkColumnView` uses a single CSS node named columnview. It may carry the
.column-separators style class, when [`ColumnView:show-column-separators`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#property:show-column-separators)
property is set. Header widgets appear below a node with name header.
The rows are contained in a `GtkListView` widget, so there is a listview
node with the same structure as for a standalone `GtkListView` widget.
If [`ColumnView:show-row-separators`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#property:show-row-separators) is set, it will be passed
on to the list view, causing its CSS node to carry the .separators style class.
For rubberband selection, a node with name rubberband is used.

The main columnview node may also carry style classes to select
the style of [list presentation](section-list-widget.html#list-styles):
.rich-list, .navigation-sidebar or .data-table.

# Accessibility

`GtkColumnView` uses the [`AccessibleRole.tree_grid`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:tree_grid) role, header title
widgets are using the [`AccessibleRole.column_header`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:column_header) role. The row widgets
are using the [`AccessibleRole.row`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:row) role, and individual cells are using
the [`AccessibleRole.grid_cell`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:grid_cell) role

append_column.brief: Appends the `column` to the end of the columns in `self`.
append_column.md: Appends the `column` to the end of the columns in `self`.

get_columns.brief: Gets the list of columns in this column view.
get_columns.md:
Gets the list of columns in this column view.

This list is constant over the lifetime of `self` and can be used to
monitor changes to the columns of `self` by connecting to the
[`ListModel::items-changed`](xref:gtk:Gio.ListModel#event:items-changed) signal.

get_enable_rubberband.brief: Returns whether rows can be selected by dragging with the mouse.
get_enable_rubberband.md: Returns whether rows can be selected by dragging with the mouse.

get_header_factory.brief: Gets the factory that's currently used to populate section headers.
get_header_factory.md: Gets the factory that's currently used to populate section headers.

get_model.brief: Gets the model that's currently used to read the items displayed.
get_model.md: Gets the model that's currently used to read the items displayed.

get_show_column_separators.brief: Returns whether the list should show separators between columns.
get_show_column_separators.md: Returns whether the list should show separators between columns.

get_show_row_separators.brief: Returns whether the list should show separators between rows.
get_show_row_separators.md: Returns whether the list should show separators between rows.

get_single_click_activate.brief: Returns whether rows will be activated on single click and selected on hover.
get_single_click_activate.md:
Returns whether rows will be activated on single click and
selected on hover.

get_sorter.brief: Returns a special sorter that reflects the users sorting choices in the column view.

get_tab_behavior.brief: Gets the behavior set for the <kbd>Tab</kbd> key.
get_tab_behavior.md: Gets the behavior set for the <kbd>Tab</kbd> key.

insert_column.brief: Inserts a column at the given position in the columns of `self`.
insert_column.md:
Inserts a column at the given position in the columns of `self`.

If `column` is already a column of `self`, it will be repositioned.

remove_column.brief: Removes the `column` from the list of columns of `self`.
remove_column.md: Removes the `column` from the list of columns of `self`.

scroll_to.brief: Scroll to the row at the given position - or cell if a column is given - and performs the actions specified in `flags`.
scroll_to.md:
Scroll to the row at the given position - or cell if a column is
given - and performs the actions specified in `flags`.

This function works no matter if the columnview is shown or focused.
If it isn't, then the changes will take effect once that happens.

set_enable_rubberband.brief: Sets whether selections can be changed by dragging with the mouse.
set_enable_rubberband.md: Sets whether selections can be changed by dragging with the mouse.

set_header_factory.brief: Sets the factory to use for populating the [`ListHeader`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListHeader) objects used in section headers.
set_header_factory.md:
Sets the factory to use for populating the
[`ListHeader`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListHeader) objects used in section headers.

If this factory is set to `NULL`, the list will not show
section headers.

set_model.md:
Sets the model to use.

This must be a [`SelectionModel`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SelectionModel).

set_reorderable.brief: Sets whether columns should be reorderable by dragging.
set_reorderable.md: Sets whether columns should be reorderable by dragging.

set_row_factory.brief: Sets the factory used for configuring rows.
set_row_factory.md:
Sets the factory used for configuring rows.

The factory must be for configuring [`ColumnViewRow`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnViewRow) objects.

If this factory is not set - which is the default - then the defaults
will be used.

This factory is not used to set the widgets displayed in the individual
cells. For that see [`GtkColumnViewColumn.set_factory()`](xref:gtk:GtkColumnViewColumn#method:set_factory) and
[`GtkColumnViewCell`](xref:gtk:GtkColumnViewCell).

set_show_column_separators.brief: Sets whether the list should show separators between columns.
set_show_column_separators.md: Sets whether the list should show separators between columns.

set_show_row_separators.brief: Sets whether the list should show separators between rows.
set_show_row_separators.md: Sets whether the list should show separators between rows.

set_single_click_activate.brief: Sets whether rows should be activated on single click and selected on hover.
set_single_click_activate.md:
Sets whether rows should be activated on single click and
selected on hover.

set_tab_behavior.md:
Sets the <kbd>Tab</kbd> key behavior.

This influences how the <kbd>Tab</kbd> and
<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> keys move the
focus in the columnview.

sort_by_column.brief: Sets the sorting of the view.
sort_by_column.md:
Sets the sorting of the view.

This function should be used to set up the initial sorting.
At runtime, users can change the sorting of a column view
by clicking on the list headers.

This call only has an effect if the sorter returned by
[`ColumnView.get_sorter()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#method:get_sorter) is set on a sort model,
and [`ColumnViewColumn.set_sorter()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnViewColumn#method:set_sorter) has been called
on `column` to associate a sorter with the column.

If `column` is unset, the view will be unsorted.

header-factory.md:
Factory for creating header widgets.

The factory must be for configuring [`ListHeader`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListHeader) objects.

row-factory.brief: The factory used for configuring rows.
row-factory.md:
The factory used for configuring rows.

The factory must be for configuring [`ColumnViewRow`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnViewRow) objects.

single-click-activate.brief: Activate rows on single click and select them on hover.
single-click-activate.md: Activate rows on single click and select them on hover.

sorter.brief: Sorter with the sorting choices of the user.
sorter.md: Sorter with the sorting choices of the user.

activate.brief: Emitted when a row has been activated by the user, usually via activating the GtkListBase|list.activate-item action.
activate.md:
Emitted when a row has been activated by the user, usually via activating
the GtkListBase|list.activate-item action.

This allows for a convenient way to handle activation in a columnview.
See [`ListItem.set_activatable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:set_activatable) for details on how to use this
signal.
